severity: RESOLVED — was blocks-distribute; root cause found + fix verified (C00 real-device PASS)

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: AVD-name mismatch (class d), NOT a boot hang. The api34-x86_64 image bakes exactly ONE AVD named 'default'; the runner passed 'CZ_API34_Phone' (from --avds AND the default BASE_AVDS matrix) → the entrypoint pre-check exits(1) in ~4s ('AVD not found') → the container's --rm auto-removes it, erasing the log → WaitForBoot (which has NO container-liveness check) polls the now-dead forwarded port until its own deadline, misreporting the 4s exit as a 5m/12m 'boot timeout' (boot_seconds 301/721 = the WaitForBoot deadline, not a real boot). GPU (swiftshader_indirect — correct) and KVM/TCG (KVM IS engaged: kvm-vm + 4 kvm-vcpu inodes captured) were both RULED OUT by captured evidence. Diagnosed by subagent a76093bd with hard evidence.
resolution.fix: Invoke with the AVD name the image actually bakes: scripts/run-challenge-matrix.sh --test-class <T> --avds 'default:34:phone'. Proven end-to-end.

verification_C00_PASS.note: Cold-boot under KVM in 44.5s; C00 crash-survival PASS against the fresh 1.3.14-1080 debug APK. The §6.Z device gate is now producing real evidence on this host.

durable_fixes_owed: run-challenge-matrix.sh: the default §6.AE.2 BASE_AVDS names (CZ_API*_Phone) do not match the api34 image's baked AVD 'default' → a plain gate run hits the SAME mismatch. Align the single-image path's AVD name to the baked name, OR make the image→AVD-name mapping explicit in tools/lava-containers/vm-images.json. (Gate-shaping script — §6.N.1.2 Bluff-Audit rehearsal required.)

submodules/containers pkg/emulator/containerized.go WaitForBoot: add a container-liveness check (podman inspect .State.Running / exit code) + surface `podman logs` before --rm reaps the container, so a 4s exit(1) is not disguised as a multi-minute boot timeout. (Containers submodule change + pin bump.)
Full §6.AE matrix (API 28/30/latest × phone/tablet) still needs those emulator images + baked AVD names — only api34-x86_64 (AVD 'default') is local.

WaitForBoot timed out after 12m0s waiting for sys.boot_completed=1

diagnosis: CONFIRMED: it is a boot HANG, not a slow-but-progressing boot — 12 minutes was insufficient exactly as 5 minutes was, and the guest never reaches sys.boot_completed. CONFIRMED: this is NOT the §6.AH KVM-absence class (KVM is present, accessible, and passed to the container via --device /dev/kvm per submodules/containers/pkg/emulator/containerized.go:102). This matches the prior sessions' 'QA device gate broken — keystones SKIP/FAIL on containerized emulator'. PENDING_FORENSICS: the exact boot-stall cause — candidate classes are (a) emulator GPU mode in the headless container (the emulator launch flags live in the image entrypoint, not containerized.go; a mode other than swiftshader_indirect/off can hang the guest at boot animation), (b) KVM acceleration not actually engaged INSIDE the rootless-podman container namespace despite --device /dev/kvm (falling back to TCG software emulation → a full boot can exceed even 12m), (c) an image/kernel-6.12 incompatibility. Distinguishing these requires a manual container boot with adb logcat + `getprop` + verifying qemu's accel inside the container — a focused Containers-submodule investigation.
anti_bluff_conclusion: The distribute is device-gate-BLOCKED and MUST NOT proceed on faked/absent device evidence (§6.Z clause 2 + 6, §6.AK, §6.L). The runner behaved correctly: it reported FAIL + RC=1 + 'MATRIX FAILED — tag.sh MUST refuse this commit' rather than emitting a green verdict. This is the anti-bluff gate working as designed.
bluff_classification: green-verdict-on-non-booting-emulator — the bluff this incident would represent IF the matrix runner had emitted a PASS/green verdict despite the Android guest never reaching sys.boot_completed (the exact class of the 2026-07-03 stale-verdict-PASS bluff that was already fixed in run-iteration/run-matrix).
